lines: That idea is bent past repair.
Even a cracked handle shows better judgment than that.
Careful. Even steel looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken tools with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
You are a loose handle waiting to embarrass someone.
I have sharpened stones with more promise.
That idea is dull and badly balanced.
Your manners need repair and a new grip.
Even a broken hoe knows what job it failed at.
You swing confidence like an axe with no edge.
I would not hang that opinion on the tool rack.
A chipped blade has better focus.
Your sense rattles like a head loose on the haft.
That remark missed the nail and hit the bench.
You make a bent shovel look reliable.
I could fix three tools before finding your point.
A dull saw has more bite.
You are the reason I check balance twice.
That thought broke before the first swing.
You are using your manners like the wrong tool for the job.
I have seen bad grips with more sense than that.
Careful. Even cold iron feels warmer than your welcome.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I would trust a cracked ladder before I trusted you.
The village remembers what you did, even if you pretend not to.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not mistake my patience for fear.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
Take another step and you will learn how heavy this hammer is.
I know the sound of something about to break. You are making it now.
No tool on my wall is dull enough to suit you.
You have worn out your welcome and most of my restraint.
I would tell you to make yourself useful, but we both know better.
Get away from my bench before I clear it the hard way.
You bring more damage than anything I have repaired this week.
Save the threats. I have heard sharper things from a rusty saw.
I am done giving you chances to behave.
Turn around. Nothing here is for you.
